cards.title: When to continue
items: Continue while any key point is unsettled. A local check prepares the next letter; it does not settle a point.
Send rejected, narrowed, or corrected points back with reasons; a point is settled only after the reviewer answers.

cards.title: When to stop
items: Stop when every point is agreed, resolved by evidence, or a reasoned disagreement. Default cap: 4 follow-ups within scope and budget.
At the cap, or when a user decision or new material is needed, stop and report both positions. Never concede just to finish.
